story.text: Starliner is expected to return without its crew in early September.
Wilmore and Williams are expected to return with Crew-9 in February.
In August NASA decided to bring Starliner back without the two astronauts.

proposals.text: Starliner landed without its crew in New Mexico on September 6, local time.
Wilmore and Williams returned to Earth aboard the Crew-9 Dragon on March 18.
